1.natural_language: Rewire friendships so an idea reaches everyone. A person joins when their convinced-friend fraction reaches the fraction on their portrait. Thick friendships are fixed. Stay within the visible changed-link limit. Run, inspect the stall, and repair freely. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any implementation or hidden-state access. Do not interact with unrelated, pre-existing, blank, or browser-settings tabs. Only tabs opened by visible task controls as part of the task are allowed, and only their visible controls may be used.
